data.name: Fatheha
data.gender_notes: Fatheha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatheha is an Arabic name derived from the root letters 'FaTha' and 'Haa'. It means 'giver of goodness' or 'opener of the heart to the truth'. In Islamic teachings, Fatimah bint Muhammad, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad, is often referred to as 'Umm Al-Fadl' (Mother of Goodness) due to her exceptional virtues and piety.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of compassion and benevolence, Fatheha represents the spirit of generosity and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Fatheha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Goodness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatheha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fatheha has a profound cultural impact in the Muslim world and beyond, as it is associated with the revered figure of Fatima bint Muhammad, one of the most beloved and respected women in Islamic history. Her life and teachings are a model for Muslim women, who strive to emulate her piety, dedication, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Fatheha lies in its etymology, which signifies the giver of goodness or the one who opens the heart to the truth. In Islamic teachings, this name is a reminder to seek and spread goodness in the world, following the example of Fatima bint Muhammad and other righteous figures. It also signifies the importance of having an open heart to respond to divine guidance, to learn and grow spiritually.
